method: DerSimonian-Laird random effects on log RR; SE from the 95% Wald interval as (log upper - log lower) / (2 × 1.96); effects rejected by the study rules ('rejected') and strata that failed outright ('stratum_errors') are counted and left out; regions the study refused have no report and are not counted

confounders.inference: natural time spline, 7 df/year, no harmonics
confounders.autocorrelation_sensitivity: Newey-West (HAC, 7 lags) interval; log of previous-day admissions as a covariate
